name: stageshow
title: stageshow
description: Build faux product UI that looks like a real product — a still illustration or an animated demo with a cursor — for marketing pages, feature cards and docs heroes: browser/app windows, dashboards, phones, notifications, terminals, bento grids and cursor walkthroughs, framed, masked and cropped like a polished marketing site. React and plain CSS.
why: No entry does faux product UI stills + animated cursor demos for marketing — the capability was genuinely unoccupied. Closest neighbours do different jobs: emil-design-eng is motion-craft judgment for real products, ui-ux-pro-max/ui-styling build real UIs, and the GSAP skills animate real products; stageshow stages fake-but-believable product UI as illustrations, with a copyable React kit (Stage/Window/Phone/Act API), 60+ gold examples and a film/--gate rehearsal loop. Honest limits: React-only kit; third-party brand/app-icon assets are excluded from the MIT (NOTICE.md + kit/brands/SOURCES.md travel with the import); one-month maintenance record (repo created 2026-10-26, last push 2026-11-05); minor version mismatch (frontmatter 1.1.1 vs package.json 0.1.0).
requires: browser binary for the film/--gate loop (optional)
